1.title: California Blocked an Oil Pipeline in Santa Barbara. Trump Forced It Open.
1.summary: The reopening of the pipeline has made residents anxious in a region prized for its gorgeous beaches and ocean views.

2.title: Lindsey Graham’s Sister Darline Nordone Was His Family
2.summary: After the senator and his sister, Darline, lost their parents, he guided her through the teenage years and into college. He called her success the highlight of his life.

3.title: Mercurial and Magnetic, Lindsey Graham Was a Force in the Senate
3.summary: The sharp-witted South Carolinian repaired relations with President Trump to advance his foreign policy goals, was willing to cut deals with Democrats and tried to insert himself into every legislative fight.

4.title: At least 28 killed, 25 critically injured after fire engulfs Bangkok bar
4.summary: Firefighters arrived at the scene in the Chatuchak district to find patrons running through flames to escape.

5.title: Live Updates: U.S. and Iran Edge Toward War Again
5.summary: President Trump said the United States was renewing its blockade of shipping to and from Iran, after the two sides exchanged escalatory rhetoric and fresh attacks.

6.title: Japan Builds Intelligence Agency It Hasn’t Had Since World War II
6.summary: Facing threats from Russia and China, Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi is  turning to help from Western allies in forming a centralized agency.
